ProgramUnit.Name: SORT_QUERY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SORT_QUERY (p_sort_by in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 IF p_sort_by = 'DRIVE_TYPE' THEN
 IF p_sort_by = :ord_by THEN 
 IF :AS_DS = 'ASC' THEN
 set_block_property('DRIVES',ORDER_BY,'drive_type desc, drive_date ');
 :AS_DS := 'DESC';
 ELSE
 set_block_property('DRIVES',ORDER_BY,'drive_type, drive_date');
 :AS_DS := 'ASC';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 set_block_property('DRIVES',ORDER_BY,'drive_type, drive_date');
 :AS_DS := 'ASC';
 END IF;
 ELSIF :ord_by = p_sort_by THEN
 IF :AS_DS = 'ASC' THEN
 :AS_DS := 'DESC';
 ELSE
 :AS_DS := 'ASC';
 END IF;
 set_block_property('DRIVES',ORDER_BY,p_sort_by ||' ' || :as_ds);
 ELSIF :ord_by != p_sort_by THEN
 set_block_property('DRIVES',ORDER_BY,p_sort_by ||' ASC');
 :AS_DS := 'ASC';
 END IF;
 :ord_by := p_sort_by;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query(no_validate);
 :system.message_level := 0;
 --message(substr(:system.last_query,-80));
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DO_RETRIEVE IS
 lCount number := 0;
 lDrvCount number := 0;
 lPerm varchar2(6) ;
 tot_staff number := 0;
 drive_where_clause varchar2(2000);
begin
 if :from_date is null then
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_item('from_date');
 show_error('0080');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if :to_date is null then
 :to_date := :from_date + :lcount - 1;
 end if;

 begin

IF :control_block.drive_type = 'M' THEN
 if :control_block.facility_code is not NULL THEN
 select count(*) into lDrvCount
 from drives
 where drive_date between :from_date and :to_date
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and drive_id in ( 
 select distinct drive_id 
 from drive_facilities 
 where facility_code = 
 nvl(:control_block.facility_code, facility_code)
 )
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and ( signoff_user is not null or signoff_date is not null);

 else
 select count(*) into lDrvCount
 from drives
 where drive_date between :from_date and :to_date
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and ( signoff_user is not null or signoff_date is not null);
 end if;
ELSE
 if :control_block.facility_code is not NULL THEN
 select count(*) into lDrvCount
 from drives
 where drive_date between :from_date and :to_date
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and drive_id in ( 
 select distinct drive_id 
 from drive_facilities 
 where facility_code = 
 nvl(:control_block.facility_code, facility_code)
 )
 and drive_type like :control_block.drive_type
 and ( signoff_user is not null or signoff_date is not null);

 else
 select count(*) into lDrvCount
 from drives
 where drive_date between :from_date and :to_date
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and drive_type like :control_block.drive_type
 and ( signoff_user is not null or signoff_date is not null);
 end if;
END IF;
 if lDrvCount > 0 then
 begin
 select access_class into lPerm --MG 020199, it was pass_thru
 from valid_user_access_classes --MG 020199, it was system_users
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+2)
 and :local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(:local_date)+2) -- IM# 5320
 and access_class = 'STAFF'
 and rownum < 2;

 if nvl(lPerm, 'NONE') != 'STAFF' then
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('control_block');
 show_error('16181');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('control_block');
 show_error('9145');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end;

 if :control_block.drive_type = 'M' then
 drive_where_clause := 'drive_date between :from_date and :to_date and drives.drive_type in (''I'', ''C'') and status = ''CNFRM'' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and ( signoff_user is null or signoff_date is null)' ;
 else
 drive_where_clause := 'drive_date between :from_date and :to_date and drives.drive_type like :control_block.drive_type and status = ''CNFRM'' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and ( signoff_user is null or signoff_date is null)' ;
 end if;

 if :control_block.facility_code is not NULL THEN
 drive_where_clause := drive_where_clause || ' and drive_id 
 in ( select distinct drive_id from drive_facilities 
 where facility_code = 
 nvl(:control_block.facility_code, facility_code) ) ' ;
 end if;
 set_block_property('drives',default_where,drive_where_clause);
 set_block_property('DRIVES',ORDER_BY, 'drive_date, drive_id');
 :ord_by := 'DRIVE_DATE, DRIVE_ID';
-- go_block('drives');
 :system.message_level := 10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 first_record;
 if :drives.drive_id is not null then
 loop
 lCount := lCount +1;
 tot_staff := tot_staff + :staff_no;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 first_record;
 else
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('11113');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 :total_drives := lCount;
 :total_staff := tot_staff;
 if nvl(:total_drives,0) = 0 then
 item_change('pb_signoff','D');
 item_change('pb_cancel','D');
 item_change('pb_sel_all','D');
 item_change('pb_drive_details','D');
 else
 item_change('pb_signoff','E');
 item_change('pb_cancel','E');
 item_change('pb_sel_all','E');
 item_change('pb_drive_details','E');
 end if;
END;
